title: SPEC-0002 P4: two ports, the clock, and MIDI in (plan)

why_risk: P4 is High (timing) in docs/09; the plan proposes a change to crates/octocore (a new Event variant) and an ABI bump, which later pull requests carry. This one changes nothing but documents

evidence: F-P4-1: docs/09 lists MIDI work in the P4 row, in Wave 1 (two outputs) and in Wave 4 (input and recording, the 200 clock states, program change); the engine has no record, page sets or Grid mode (README F1; crates/octocore/src/types.rs Event has five variants)

F-P4-2: a track reaches port 2 by MidiChannel 17 to 32 (crates/octocore/src/engine.rs resolve_port_channel); apps/web/engine/ABI.md has 15 exports and none writes a track; the manual puts the port in Track zoom (Wave 2), so A6 cannot be shown from the panel

D0 arithmetic: TICKS_PER_QUARTER 192 (domain.rs line 33), samples per tick sr*60/(bpm*192) (engine.rs line 274): at 120 BPM a step (12 ticks) is 31.25 ms and a MIDI clock pulse 20.83 ms, so a step is 1.5 pulses, not 6
The scheduler already routes two ports: apps/web/src/midi-out.ts setOutput(port, output); pages/app.ts wires port 1 only
Stop while stopped already sends CC 123 on all 32 channels, unconditionally (engine.rs line 524, tests/conformance/AMBIGUITIES.md 'stop with sounding notes')
